description:
This is a sources sought for Survey Monuments, caps, and nail markers.

See attached specifications

Interested vendors please respond back with:
1. CAGE Code
2. Unique Entity ID
3. A evidence that you are:
I. a manufacturer (or a possible manufacturer) of requested survey equipment that is price competitive to Berntsen https://www.berntsen.com/Surveying/Survey-Monuments/Drive-in-Monuments-Wetland-Monuments/Wetland-Survey-Monuments
or
II. an authorized reseller of the requested equipment that has been successfully used in survey work in the US.

Please identify "140F0S26Q0021 - Sources Sought for Survey Monuments, caps, and nail markers" in the subject line of your email to Robert_Sung@fws.gov
